events.description: Get ready for a spooktacular Halloween adventure at Fox Valley Mall! 👻🍬 Dress in your Halloween best, grab your trick-or-treat bucket and set out on a scavenger hunt throughout the mall to find 16 costumed characters , snap photos and collect treats along the way! 👻 How It Works 🎃 Start at the check-in table on the Lower Level across from Cinnabon to make your required donation and receive your scavenger hunt directions. 🔎 Follow the hunt throughout Fox Valley Mall to find 8 stops throughout the center. 📸 Stop for photos with your favorites and collect candy and giveaways along the way, while supplies last. ⏰ Please Note: All characters will take a required break from 10:45–10:55 AM and will not be available for photos or meet-and-greets during this time. The scavenger hunt will resume immediately following the break. 🍬 Don’t forget to bring your trick-or-treat bucket or bag! ✨ Meet 16 Characters! 🎃 Mickey & Minnie 💙 Stitch & Angel 🍄 Mario & Peach 🐶 Bluey & Bingo 🤠 Woody & Jessie 🕷️ Spider-Man & Hulk 🎤 Rumi & Derpy 💛 Minions Can you find them all? 👀 🧥 REQUIRED DONATION TO PARTICIPATE Each person participating in the scavenger hunt must donate ONE of the following at check-in:🧥 ONE new or gently used coat per person OR 💵 $1 per person Donations are required for EACH participant over 1 year old, including both children and adults participating in the scavenger hunt. One coat or $1 does not cover an entire family or group. For example, a family of four participating can donate four coats, $4, or a combination of coats and dollars totaling one donation per person.
